_comment: sim-robust-transfer-preplace-reach-v1 live_pose TRANSFER preplace REACH/branch fix. Purpose: make the full-chain live_pose transfer preplace reach a HOLDABLE goal from the pose the real coupled tow actually parks the base in, instead of streaming the un-reachable deep shoulder fold (coldwin6: the arm froze 0.35 rad short at ur_shoulder_lift -3.65 -> PATH_TOLERANCE_VIOLATED -> HOST_FAULT_ESTOP phase=preplace). The preplace standoff above the bay has two wrist-CLEAR IK branches: a holdable UPRIGHT one (ur_shoulder_lift ~ -1.95, fold_droop ~0.38) and a DEEP fold (~ -4.0, fold_droop ~3.85) the arm cannot reach. The staged recorded_bay_park runs (armcam4/armcameco/htsim) accept the upright branch at the first seed; the full chain parks slightly differently, KDL's measured seed lands in the deep branch, and the wrist-flip re-seed that clears the wrist converges to the deep-fold clear twin -- which the plain wrist-guard ACCEPTED. A reachable upright clear branch provably EXISTS at the coldwin6 park pose (CPU: tests/test_restock_transfer_preplace_reach.py). This ONE HOST-config key steers the preplace IK to it and rejects a clear-but-deep-fold goal by name. Merge it into the mission runtime-config HOST block (read by scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_host.py). Absent/false => the plain wrist-guard (byte-identical).
_transfer_preplace_reach_guard_note: true => defaults (max_droop 2.0, upright_seed [0.0, -1.9, 2.0, -0.1, 1.6, 0.0] in ARM order: ur_shoulder_pan, ur_shoulder_lift, ur_elbow, ur_wrist_1, ur_wrist_2, ur_wrist_3). Or a mapping {"max_droop": 2.0, "upright_seed": [...]}: max_droop is the holdable shoulder-fold envelope (fold_droop = |wrap(ur_shoulder_lift) - (-pi/2)|; upright ~0.38, deep fold ~3.85, so 2.0 separates them cleanly); upright_seed (null/absent keeps the default generic seed; false drops the seed, leaving only the fold-acceptance test) is tried FIRST FALLBACK after the measured seed so the seeded-KDL IK finds the holdable branch. When active, the live_pose transfer PREPLACE's wrist-guarded KDL goal must be BOTH wrist-clear AND a holdable fold; a clear-but-deep goal is rejected and the upright seed is tried, and if no clear+reachable branch exists from this park pose the move fails fast with the named reason 'transfer preplace: no wrist-clear IK branch within the reachable shoulder-fold envelope (fold_droop<=X)' rather than streaming the infeasible goal.
_scope: Scoped to the live_pose transfer PREPLACE (RESTOCK_TRANSFER_MODE=live_pose + RESTOCK_TRANSFER_CARRY=wrist_guard). The pick (cuMotion) and the place/retreat (collision-off straight-line) are untouched; collect and every non-live_pose transfer are untouched. The staged recorded_bay_park transfer already accepts the upright branch at seed 0, so this key leaves the staged-start path byte-identical in outcome.
_requires: The HOST block must already carry RESTOCK_TRANSFER_CARRY=wrist_guard active for the transfer (this guard extends it), i.e. the existing live_pose transfer carry setup (carry_wrist1_cap / carry_wrist2_min = the clear region, defaults 0.65 / 0.0). Register transfer_preplace_reach_guard in the run's --require preflight (config_preflight knows it as a HOST key).
_bounded_gpu_proof: The real proof is the full capstone chain (collect -> couple -> outbound -> park -> transfer), since the staged start cannot reproduce the full-chain park pose that triggers the deep branch. Re-run the coldwin6 capstone (capstone241 config: tow_lane_goal_stop on, station gap 30, settle+economy on, live_pose, every stage honest, cold full chain) under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock with HEAVY_MB respected (whispr ~2.2 GB), with this key merged into the HOST block. Expected PASS: HOST_EFFECTIVE_CONFIG shows transfer_preplace_reach_guard active; the console logs 'TRANSFER_CARRY preplace_reach_guard active'; at preplace a 'WRIST_GUARD reject-deepfold ... -> next seed' then a 'WRIST_GUARD accept' with ur_shoulder_lift near -1.95 (holdable); the preplace move tracks to goal (no PATH_TOLERANCE_VIOLATED, no 'frozen ... rad short'); transfer proceeds through place -> verify. If a particular park pose has NO clear+reachable branch, the move fails fast with the named reach-envelope reason (then the park-standoff derivation documented in data/sim-robust-transfer-preplace-reach-v1/report.md is the follow-up).
